top_signals.title: Burnham says UK has ‘lost more than it gained’ from Brexit
top_signals.summary: Andy Burnham has warned Britain has “lost more than we’ve gained” since Brexit as he prepares for a Brussels summit aimed at cutting trade barriers and boosting economic growth. Speaking at the Welsh Labour conference on Saturday, Burnham accused the Conservatives of delivering a harder Brexit than voters expected, arguing that closer ties with the [...]
